solo_execution_exception_rationale: AppMaker currently operates with one human (pawedo@gmail.com) as sole authorized human. Amendment Process meta-rule requires dual human review for amendments touching core rules (R4/R5/R6/R8/R11/R13). R18 semantically touches R5 (fail-closed gates) and R13 (uncertainty reduction). Strict reading applied per WU-004 contract; human_secondary requirement is satisfied by recording this solo_execution_exception entry. This sets first-amendment precedent for solo operation. Solo exception is procedural acknowledgment, not break-glass: the rule still applies and is still enforced (fail-closed by default), but documentation of the exception is the substitute for the absent second reviewer until AppMaker grows beyond one operator.
